mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_reviews (id, product_id, product_name, user_id, user_name, order_id, rating, title, content, images, status, merchant_reply, replied_at, replied_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{orderId}, #{rating}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images, typeHandler=com.example.backend.config.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{merchantReply}, #{repliedAt}, #{repliedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE product_reviews SET product_id = #{productId}, product_name = #{productName}, user_id = #{userId}, user_name = #{userName}, order_id = #{orderId}, rating = #{rating}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, images = #{images, typeHandler=com.example.backend.config.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, status = #{status}, merchant_reply = #{merchantReply}, replied_at = #{repliedAt}, replied_by = #{repliedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id, product_name, user_id, user_name, rating, title, content, status, merchant_reply, created_at FROM product_reviews ORDER BY created_at DESC
